title: Single-molecule quantum tunnelling sensors
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00375F, Review Article
Long Yi, Yuxin Yang, Biao-Feng Zeng, Xu Liu, Joshua B. Edel, Aleksandar P. Ivanov, Longhua Tang
This review summarises advances in single-molecule quantum tunnelling sensors, including sensing principles, device design, and functional applications in chemistry and biology.
